title: Summit Village Private Beach (HOA) Bellaire Beach Club
html:
Website: https://www.shantycreek.com/venue/summit-village/

Phone: 231‑533‑8621

Lake Bellaire – minutes away
Private access included with your stay (Summit Village HOA guest pass required)

This exclusive beach is nestled within the Summit Village community of Shanty Creek Resort and is available only to Summit Village HOA members and their guests. With 350 feet of sandy shoreline, lounge chairs, shaded grassy areas, grills, a playground, and clean restroom facilities, it’s a perfect place to relax or play all day.

Enjoy sunrise views over the lake, a family-friendly environment, and a quiet, resort-style atmosphere just minutes from the property.

FAQs:

  • Is this beach open to the public?
    No, it’s only accessible to Summit Village HOA members and their registered guests—your Airbnb stay includes access!
  • Do I need a pass to enter?
    Yes—a guest pass is required and will be provided upon check-in or through the host.
  • Are there facilities on-site?
    Yes! You’ll find restrooms, BBQ grills, lounge chairs, grassy picnic areas, and even a playground.
  • Is it good for kids?
    Absolutely—it’s family-friendly, quiet, and well-maintained, with plenty of space to play safely.
  • Can we bring food or drinks?
    Yes! Pack a cooler, fire up the grill, and enjoy a lakeside picnic. Just please clean up after use.

title: The Beach Club – Public Beach on Lake Bellaire
html:
View on MapQuest – The Beach Club, Bellaire MI: https://www.mapquest.com/us/michigan/the-beach-club-437526895

Location Guide: The Beach Club, Bellaire, MI 49615 (near Forest Home Township)
Phone: N/A (public managed area)

Access: Open to the public, no fees or passes required - minutes away from the cabin

The Beach Club on Lake Bellaire is a charming, low-key public beach that’s perfect for families and laid-back travelers. Enjoy soft sand under your feet, crystal-clear waters for swimming, and plenty of open space to lay down a towel or set up a picnic. Tucked among trees and greenery, it’s a peaceful, uncrowded alternative to busier lakefronts—ideal for sunbathing, swimming, or simply enjoying the lake’s natural beauty.

FAQs – What Guests Should Know:

  • Do I need a pass or pay an entrance fee?
    Nope! It’s completely free and open to the public—just show up and enjoy.
  • Are there picnic areas or tables?
    While there are no formal tables, the beach offers grassy spots and open sand perfect for beach blankets or lawn chairs.
  • Is it suitable for swimming?
    Yes! The water is clean and shallow enough for safe swimming and wading.
  • Is there parking available?
    Yes, but it’s limited—arrive early on weekends to grab a spot, especially in summer.
  • Any tips for first-timers?
    Bring sunscreen, towels, snacks, and your beach chairs. There are no lifeguards or concessions, so pack accordingly.

title: Torch Lake Sandbar
html:
A Must-Visit Gem Near Bellaire, MI

Website: https://torchlake.com
Phone: (231) 533-8818
Location: Torch Lake, about 20 minutes by boat from Bellaire, MI

Access: Best reached by boat, kayak, or jet ski; rentals available nearby

Just 20 minutes by boat from Bellaire, Torch Lake Sandbar is famous for its stunning, crystal-clear turquoise waters and soft sandy bottom. Perfect for swimming, sunbathing, and boating, it’s a must-visit spot for a relaxing day on the water. Bring your snacks and sunscreen, and enjoy this beautiful natural gem!

FAQs – What Guests Should Know

  • How do I get there?
    You’ll need a boat or watercraft—rent from a nearby marina or charter a cruise with a captain for a no-hassle trip.
  • Can we swim at the sandbar?
    Yes! The water is shallow, warm, and perfect for swimming and wading.
  • Can we bring drinks and snacks?
    Absolutely! BYOB and picnic-friendly—just be respectful and take your trash with you.
  • Is it a party spot or family-friendly?
    It can be both! Weekends often bring a lively crowd, while weekdays are more relaxed.
  • When’s the best time to go?
    Arrive early in the day for calmer waters and easy anchoring—especially on weekends and holidays.

Embark on scenic hikes through diverse landscapes, including hardwood forests, wetlands, and coastal dunes. The sandy beach at Rex Beach invites you to relax, swim, or enjoy a peaceful picnic with breathtaking lake views.

Whether you're seeking a quiet escape or an adventure in nature, Antrim Creek Natural Area & Rex Beach offers a perfect blend of outdoor recreation and natural beauty, just a short drive from Bellaire.
